kept.title: Tiimo 'make it yours' icon picker
kept.kind: app screenshots of ADHD-oriented todo apps
kept.caption: Tiimo's grid of colourful emoji task icons shows the cosmetic personalisation that gives an app its early-days novelty hit, which is the kind of surface delight that fades once the newness is gone.

kept.title: Tiimo home-screen widgets
kept.trait: Out of sight, out of mind
kept.caption: iPhone home screen with Tiimo timer and to-do widgets puts tasks and a countdown in view without opening the app, countering out-of-sight-out-of-mind.

kept.title: Tiimo voice/AI capture prompt
kept.caption: Tiimo's 'What should we tackle next?' screen with a microphone button and a spoken brain-dump shows one-step voice capture that minimises the taps needed to add tasks.

kept.title: Time Timer physical timer and app
kept.kind: visual timer and time-blocking UI screens
kept.caption: The Time Timer shows remaining time as a shrinking red disc, making elapsed time visible at a glance for people with time blindness.

kept.title: Tiimo AI task breakdown output
kept.caption: A rambling spoken to-do is turned into separate timed tasks ('Do laundry 30m', 'Yoga', 'Pick up kids') ready to add, lowering the barrier to starting by decomposing the mess.

kept.title: Things 3 for Mac main window
kept.kind: app screenshots of ADHD-oriented todo apps
kept.caption: Things 3's sidebar of Inbox, Upcoming, Anytime, Someday plus areas, projects and headings shows how much structure an app invites users to build and tweak instead of doing tasks.
kept.credit: Wikimedia Commons, Things 3 screenshot (modern software screenshot)

kept.title: Focusmate session booking steps
kept.kind: app screenshots of ADHD-oriented todo apps
kept.caption: Focusmate's three steps (book sessions, sync calendar, join from browser) illustrate virtual co-working, the body-doubling feature that adds accountability by scheduling a live partner.

kept.title: Sunsama break reminder prompt
kept.caption: A 'Ready for a break?' prompt with response choices shows a reminder that asks for an answer instead of pinging blindly, the kind of interactive nudge meant to resist becoming ignored noise.

kept.title: Tiimo visual daily plan
kept.kind: app screenshots of ADHD-oriented todo apps
kept.caption: The day view collapses tasks into labelled sections with counts (Morning (3), Day (2)) so only a slice of the list shows at once, countering long flat lists.

kept.title: Finch self-care pet app preview
kept.kind: app screenshots of ADHD-oriented todo apps
kept.caption: Finch's cartoon birds are the pet-and-cuteness hook that drives a burst of early engagement, the honeymoon style reward that tends to wear off (modern marketing art).

kept.title: Tiimo desktop week time-blocking view
kept.kind: visual timer and time-blocking UI screens
kept.caption: The week calendar lays tasks as timed blocks with durations (1.5h, 30 mins) and a running routine timer, making time visible.

kept.title: Tiimo Apple Watch focus timer
kept.kind: visual timer and time-blocking UI screens
kept.caption: An Apple Watch face shows the task 'Laundry' with a circular progress ring and '13 mins left', a wrist-level visual countdown.

kept.title: Tiimo to-do lists with completion confetti
kept.kind: app screenshots of ADHD-oriented todo apps
kept.caption: Checking off a task triggers a purple confetti burst and a small streak counter, the reward-feedback layer of gamified todo apps.
